fields.name: gene
fields.description: Ensembl ID using official IGVF GENCODE version (V43)

fields.name: gene_symbol
fields.description: Gene symbol from official IGVF GENCODE version (V43)

fields.name: score
fields.description: Program score or loading derived from the method. Positive values indicate a positive relationship between the program and the gene, while a negative value indicates an inverse relationship.

fields.name: program_annotation
fields.description: Free text description/annotation corresponding to program_id

fields.name: program_annotation_term
fields.description: Ontology-controlled term for annotation, e.g. using GO (Gene ontology; https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/cl)

fields.name: program_annotation_id
fields.description: ontology term ID matching #program_annotation_term, representing an ontology-controlled term ID
